name: Városlőd (Hungary)
description: A vertical pale turquoise banner charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Városlőd (a quartered red, yellow, blue and green shield with a sabre, an oak bough and tools) below the name VÁROSLŐD in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
